combined_loan_to_value_ratio.decisive_threshold_basis: Comparability floor at the gate reference (L=$270k, V=$285k): d(CLTV)/d(L)=3.51e-4 pp/$ times the loan_amount control slack of $20,000 = 7.02 pp. Irreducible floor from publication binning alone (matcher tolerance zero) is 2.42 pp RSS / 3.42 pp worst case, because loan_amount and property_value are both published at $10,000 bin midpoints and CLTV is their ratio. A sub-percentage-point CLTV margin is therefore not measurable on the public record at any tolerance. Threshold set above the floor.

debt_to_income_ratio.decisive_threshold_basis: One integer step. DTI is published at 1pp only in 36-49; outside that range the published bucket is >=10pp wide, which cannot carry a materiality standard. The dimension is therefore RESTRICTED to the integer region: a pair with either value outside 36-49 returns below_resolution rather than being judged against a 10pp bucket.

note: reported_or_derived is DECLARED. If a dimension is derived its propagated granularity must be shown and it will very likely close the band -- that is the gate working.
